# Ashlar Studio

> Ashlar Studio (formerly SPK Buildwell) is an architecture, interior design and urban planning studio in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. It is led by architect and urban planner Pranav Kadoo (Founder & Principal Architect) with Shivani Kadoo (Senior Architect). The studio designs residences, restaurants and commercial spaces in Nagpur, including Chinchbhawan, Shankarpur and Jafar Nagar.

- City: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
- Phone: +91 77578 41518, +91 77989 28535
- Email: hello@ashlarstudio.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–16:00 IST

## Services
- [All services](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/services): architecture, interior design, BIM, 3D visualization and walkthroughs, urban planning, sustainable design, renovation, turnkey solutions, land & building valuation. Includes an FAQ on process, timelines and fees.

## Service pages
- [Architects in Nagpur](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/services/architecture): bungalows, G+2/G+3 homes and commercial buildings; NMC/NMRDA approval drawings, climate-responsive design, process, FAQs

## Projects (Nagpur)
- [Wankhede Residence, Chinchbhawan](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/wankhede-residence): three-storey home with a jaali-screened facade frame
- [Yogesh Dekate Residence, Shankarpur](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/yogesh-dekate-residence): cantilevered frames with vertical fin cladding
- [Dhoke Residence, Shankarpur](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/dhoke-residence): narrow-plot home with a brick stair tower
- [Thakre Residence, Chinchbhawan](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/thakre-residence): four storeys, glazed living level, stilt parking
- [Khan Residence, Jafar Nagar](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/khan-residence): corner-plot home with terracotta-tone cladding
- [Barange Residence](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/barange-residence)
- [Ravi Rathore Residence](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/ravi-rathore-residence)
- [Chimote Residence](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/chimote-residence)
- [El Dorado Garden Restaurant](https://ashlar-studio.vercel.app/projects/el-dorado-garden-restaurant): open-air restaurant with private timber booths, plus a 3D walkthrough video
